Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included & Fixed in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Watch Page v2 Overhaul (YouTube-Style Layout & Controls):
   - 5-Servers-Per-Page Switcher ("Other servers"): `Servers & audio` now shows
     at most 5 servers per page (`Server 1`–`Server 5`) in both SUB and DUB
     columns, with an `"Other servers"` button underneath that flips cleanly to
     the next 5 (`Server 6`–`Server 10`, plus `"‹  Servers 1–5"` to flip back),
     automatically opening on whichever page holds the currently active server.
   - 3-Row YouTube-Style Episode Playlist Card: `Episodes` now displays at most
     3 visible episode rows (`3 × 52dp`) inside a nested-scroll playlist card
     that scrolls smoothly inside itself like a YouTube playlist tab and
     auto-scrolls the currently playing episode into view.
   - YouTube-Style Recommended Anime Feed Below `Anime details`: Added a
     `"More anime"` vertical feed of 16:9 widescreen video cards (banner/cover
     thumbnail, gradient scrim, `SUB | DUB · X EP` badge, accent play badge,
     2-line title, and `★ score · Studio · Format · Year` subtitle) powered by
     AniList recommendations + popular fallback (`watchFeed154`); tapping any
     card resolves & opens that show directly in Kuro.
   - Removed Episode Slide-Over Drawer & Header Button: Removed the top-right
     circular 3-line episode drawer button from `WatchHeader`, disabled the
     right-side `"Episodes · X episodes · tap to play"` slide-over panel, and
     removed redundant `"Episodes"` drawer triggers from fullscreen controls.

2. 40 Anime & Manga Profile Art Sets (PFPs + Matching 16:9 Banners):
   - Expanded Profile Art from 24 to 40 character pairs (art-11 .. art-50),
     keeping all 24 existing sets and adding 16 iconic anime character PFPs +
     matching 16:9 banners: Monkey D. Luffy (Gear 5), Roronoa Zoro, Itachi
     Uchiha, Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Tanjiro Kamado, Kyojuro Rengoku,
     Killua Zoldyck, Ken Kaneki, Thorfinn, Guts, Lelouch Lamperouge, Power,
     Okarun (Turbo Granny), Zero Two, and Spike Spiegel.

3. Fixed Theme Colours Picker (All 20 Accents), MyAnimeList & AniList Two-Way
   Sync, Discord Login & Rich Presence Account Linking, Smooth Native
   Scrolling, Compact SUB | DUB Pills, Signature Violet Default, Smart DoH +
   Decoder Fallback, Multi-Layer Ad Guard, and Android 15 Edge-to-Edge Insets.
